notes: A164754_formula (A164754_mathlib.lean): for n >= 3, (a n : Z) = 4n^2 - 11n + 5, where a n counts f : Fin n x Bool -> Fin 4 with the four corner values, every value connected (ReflTransGen of same-value 4-adjacent steps) and no cell with three distinct same-value neighbours (Librandi's 4n^2+13n+8 is the same polynomial with n shifted by 3). Route: valid_iff_model (each value fills a row interval in each column; a value in both columns has a shared row that is an end of both intervals); monoL/mono (columns read 1,2,4,3 and 2,1,3,4); card_model (arrays coded bijectively by six block boundaries); card_T (nine families: (n-1)^2 + 4 C(n-1,2) + 2 C(n-2,2) + 2(n-3)). Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none (agreement with the OEIS data terms checked by certificate/brute.py for n <= 7 only).
